dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: Thanks to the Qucusaurs' protection, everything's going great! The Riders did espy some reflective objects from their vantage point — ore, if I had to guess.

dialogues.speaker: Utsil
dialogues.text: By the way, did you know that gem-related cards have some rather intriguing uses... Sorry, bit off-topic. If you need Magic Crystal Ore or something, you can just head over here.
